title: Control tinkering & attestation scratchbook - Malik
content:
Purpose: quick brain-dump while I prototype small helpers for SOC2 evidence harvest and control mapping. This is messy — notes to self and tiny commands, assumptions, and questions for the next sync with Ava.

High level intent:
- Reduce manual screenshots / manual queries by building tiny collectors for: access logs, SSO user lists, key rotation tables, and VM/network config snapshots.
- Create canonical filenames + metadata for each piece of evidence to make auditor reviews faster.

Immediate questions / unknowns:
- Which controls require full historical rotation logs vs. just 'last n rotations'? (ask audit: PRP vs. continuous evidence)
- Does Privacy team keep a separate DLP artefact that we reference, or must we export ours?
- Are HSM/KMS audit logs considered sufficient or do we need a signed attestation from infra owning team?

Data flow mapping (mini checklist):
- Source systems to pull from: SSO (Okta), KMS (AWS KMS audit logs), Cloud IAM (GCP/Azure), Logging (stack driver / datadog), CI (GitHub Actions), S3-like buckets (object manifests).
- For each source: minimal evidence = timestamped export + sha256 checksum + who exported.

Control -> evidence quick sketches (very rough):
- C-AC-01 (Logical access): Okta group membership export (CSV), last password policy change (okta audit), one-off signin anomalies (log sample)
- C-KM-02 (Key management): KMS key rotation history (kms list-keys + get-key-rotation), rotation policy doc link, screenshot of KMS policy
- C-CFG-03 (Change control): PR history for infra repo (github export), deployment approval snapshots (ticket links), CI run artifacts

Small experiments to run (priority order):
1) script: okta-export.sh -> fetch groups, users, write to evidence/okta/users-YYYYMMDD.csv + checksum
   - quick grep to validate: `jq '.[] | select(.profile.email|test("@redwood.com$"))'`
2) script: kms-rotations.py -> query KMS API, emit per-key JSON with rotation dates, attach IAM bindings snapshot
3) prototype: lightweight manifest.json for each evidence bundle: {"source":"okta","exported_by":"<user>","time":"<iso>","hash":"<sha256>"} (just need canonical field list)

Mini UX decisions (for reviewer comfort):
- Evidence filename pattern: <control>-<source>-YYYYMMDD-<shorthash>.ext
- Include a simple index.csv at root with columns: control, filename, brief-desc, created_at, exporter

Things I tried / gotchas:
- Datadog export endpoints are rate-limited; better to pull narrow time ranges and stitch.
- GCP audit logs have region-specific endpoints; need consistent timezone normalization (use UTC).
- Some teams export PDFs of policy docs — we should canonicalize to the original markdown when possible.

Audit Qs I expect (prep for answers):
- "How do you ensure exported evidence is complete and unmodified?" -> propose: checksum + signed exportrun (github action) + CI artifact link.
- "Who approves access to production logs?" -> map to SRE oncall rotation + access review cadence (quarterly).

Next actions (2-day plan):
- Build okta-export.sh + schedule local run, create sample evidence bundle (due Fri).
- Draft short README for evidence collector in repo (link to runbook and audit expectations).
- Quick sync with Ava/Ticket: TR-314 to align KMS requirements on Monday.

Random/side thoughts (notes-to-self):
- Could we run a one-off 'evidence harvest' GH action that runs all collectors and creates a single zipped attestation with index.csv and checksums? That'd be neat for reviewers.
- Consider storing immutable evidence artifacts in a dedicated storage bucket with object lock for the attestation period.

Open TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm with Legal whether export manifests require signature from data owner.
- [ ] Wire up timestamped signer (github action) so each evidence bundle has a signature.
- [ ] Build minimal UI to browse evidence index (maybe a static HTML).

Notes for meeting with Ava (3/10):
- Walk through prototype script outputs, filename conventions, and proposed index.csv.
- Ask whether auditors will want original system UIs or if data exports are fine.
- Confirm retention windows we need to support in the bucket (180 days? 365?).

End of scratchbook — this is a living page, will iterate after the Monday sync.
